name: cursor-usage-exporter
description: Send Cursor Agent token usage to Datadog custom metrics (metrics only, no logs).

DD_API_KEY.title: Datadog API key
DD_API_KEY.description: API key for submitting custom metrics (Metrics API v2).

METRIC_PREFIX.title: Metric name prefix
METRIC_PREFIX.description: Your Datadog metric namespace prefix (should end with a dot). Example: acme.
